_about: The publishing plan, read by publisher/lanes.py. slots: the only times anything posts (IST). A slot is one time ("HH:MM") or one time per weekday (mon..sun); the Inbox must start a publish run at every slot time. series: each one is a set of cards (by data.app, or data.channel + data.group for a serialized channel) and the platforms they post to. Every platform has its own pointer: the oldest card it does not have yet. order strict: every platform posts in episode order and a non-lead platform posts only what is already live on the lead. order loose: any order; new cards go to every platform at its normal slots, and cards a platform missed (failed, not connected, platform added later) go out only at its catchUpSlots, oldest first, from since. Per platform: account, slots, catchUpSlots, everyDays (at most one post per that many days), since; series values are the defaults. platforms "post_to" takes the platforms and accounts from the Inbox Channel config. after: episodes up to this number are on the lead already (posted by hand).
_slotsWhy: prime-am and prime-pm are the middles of the owner's best-times-to-post chart (27 Nov 2026), a generic starting guess to be tuned from our own stats.
